log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (none) to 7 (debug). Higher = more verbose.

log_file.description: Path to the log file, or 'Syslog' to send logs to the system logger.

log_to_syslog.description: If true, use syslog instead of file logging in General section.

unix_socket_path.description: Path to the UNIX domain socket.

unix_socket_backlog.description: Backlog for the UNIX socket listen queue.

socket_buffer_size.description: Initial size of the socket buffer.

socket_buffer_size_max_grown.description: Maximum size the socket buffer can grow to.

systemd_enabled.description: If true, enable systemd notify support.

stats_log_file.description: If true, enable file logging in Stats section.
